data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate reported a gross prior year reserve release of GBP 11.75 million in 2018, primarily stemming from the resolution of a dispute related to historic binding authority agreements which resulted in the return of claims paid. This contributed to a favourable development in prior year provisions. Additionally, the syndicate noted a net favourable development of GBP 3.5 million, comprising releases in direct Third Party Liability (Casualty) and total Reinsurance business. The overall market environment remained highly competitive, with prior year releases across Casualty classes.
raw_causal_phrases: prior year releases across a number of Casualty classes

resolution of a dispute between Newline Corporate Name Limited and a third party administrator in respect of a number of historic binding authority agreements with the Syndicate. favourable development of GBP 3.5m (2017: favourable development of GBP 14.6m); this comprises releases of GBP 1.9m in respect of direct Third Party Liability business and releases of GBP 1.5m in respect of total Reinsurance business.

data.data_quality_notes: The primary prior year development figure of -GBP 11.75m is a gross release from a specific dispute resolution. The report also states a net favourable development of GBP 3.5m, broken down into Third Party Liability and Reinsurance, which are included in lob_movements as net figures. The gross claims development triangle calculation yields a different total gross release (-GBP 42.545m) than the explicitly stated gross figure, so the narrative figure is used for prior_year_development_gbp_m. LOB movements are based on net figures as gross breakdown for the GBP 11.75m is not provided.
